title: From Meters to Machine Learning: Building AI-Ready Utilities in India
summary_en: Can AI help improve India’s power distribution utilities? An original survey of utilities in Tamil Nadu and Odisha finds that strong digital infrastructure, interoperable data, and in-house capacity will determine whether AI can deliver results at scale.

title: Transshipment Crackdowns Won’t Fix the U.S.-China Trade Imbalance
summary_en: The White House alleges that Chinese exports are being rerouted through third countries to circumvent U.S. tariffs. By analyzing transshipment activity and substantive supply chain shifts, CSIS challenges this diagnosis and highlights persistent structural issues.

title: Fast Following: Military Emulation and Twenty-First-Century Transformation
summary_en: Modern war is a contest of learning and adaptation, and the lessons travel in a matter of weeks. Fast following, or copying, improving, and fielding proven innovations at speed, is now a core competency, yet Western militaries remain slow to build it.

title: FY 2027 Defense Funding: Potential Post-Midterm Outcomes
summary_en: Congress has a full post-midterm agenda, with action needed to fund the Department of Defense and federal government and reconciliation legislation to consider. Seamus Daniels lays out the factors that will shape FY 2027 defense funding decisions after the midterms.

title: Business Support for Human Rights Defenders in an Era of Government Retrenchment
summary_en: Human rights defenders are vital partners for businesses operating around the globe. Civic space and the business operating environment are fundamentally intertwined. Businesses should, can, and have supported HRDs in their important work, and such support is more needed than ever.
